summary.technical: International collaboration for the Hyper-Kamiokande experiment; about 680 researchers have participated from 140+ institutes in 23 countries as of January 2026, per the collaboration's own page. Traces to a 2015 ICRR-KEK memorandum of understanding; the project itself was formally approved by the Japanese government in February 2020.
